syllabus_topics: Regular languages and grammars, regular expressions
Closure properties of decidable and recognizable languages
Undecidability of the halting problem (introduction to diagonalization technique)
Complexity classes: P, PSPACE, NP, EXPTIME
P versus NP and NP-complete languages
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as NOTA_FINAL = T1 + T2 + T3 + T4, where Ti is the best score obtained on test i during classes or the respective resit. The tests are graded for 4, 5, 5, and 6 points respectively. To pass the course, NOTA_FINAL must be greater than or equal to 10 points (after rounding to units). Each of the 4 tests can be retaken independently and optionally.
